title: The 100 Recipe Cookbook
description: A collection of 100 recipes across 12 categories.

recipes.title: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
ingredients: 3 tbsp melted butter, plus more for the pan
instructions: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl.
In a second bowl, whisk the buttermilk, egg and melted butter.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir until just combined; a few lumps are fine.
Heat a buttered skillet over medium heat and pour in 1/4 cup batter per pancake.
Cook until bubbles form on top, flip, and cook 1-2 minutes more until golden.

recipes.title: Creamy Scrambled Eggs
instructions: Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper until fully blended.
Melt the butter in a nonstick skillet over low heat.
Pour in the eggs and stir slowly with a spatula, pushing them from the edges to the center.
Remove from the heat while still slightly glossy, since they keep cooking.
Top with chives and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
instructions: Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Bring a pot of water to a gentle simmer and add the vinegar.
Crack each egg into a cup, swirl the water, and slide the eggs in; poach for 3 minutes.
Spread avocado on the toast, top with the poached eggs and sprinkle with red pepper flakes.

recipes.title: Overnight Oats with Berries
instructions: Combine the oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds, maple syrup and vanilla in a bowl.
Stir well and divide between two jars.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight.
Top with berries just before eating.

recipes.title: Veggie Omelette
instructions: Saute the pepper and onion in half the butter for 3 minutes, add spinach until wilted, then set aside.
Beat the eggs with salt and pepper.
Melt the remaining butter in a nonstick pan over medium heat and add the eggs.
As the edges set, lift them to let uncooked egg flow underneath.
Add the vegetables and cheese to one half, fold over, and slide onto a plate.

recipes.title: Cinnamon French Toast
ingredients: 8 slices thick bread such as brioche
instructions: Whisk the eggs, milk, cinnamon and vanilla in a shallow dish.
Dip each bread slice for about 15 seconds per side.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Cook the slices 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Serve warm with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Shakshuka
ingredients: Fresh parsley and crusty bread for serving
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet and saute the onion and pepper for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the tomatoes, season with salt, and simmer 10 minutes until thickened.
Make six wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook 5-8 minutes until the whites are set. Garnish with parsley and serve with bread.

recipes.title: Breakfast Burritos
instructions: Brown the sausage in a skillet, breaking it up, then remove and drain.
Scramble the eggs in the same pan until just set.
Warm the tortillas to make them pliable.
Fill each with eggs, sausage, potatoes, cheese and salsa.
Fold in the sides, roll tightly, and toast seam-side down in the pan for 1 minute.

recipes.title: Banana Berry Smoothie Bowl
instructions: Blend the banana, berries, yogurt and milk until thick and smooth, adding milk a splash at a time if needed.
Pour into a bowl.
Top with granola, almonds and a drizzle of honey.

recipes.title: Loaded Breakfast Hash
ingredients: Salt, pepper and smoked paprika to taste
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet and cook the potatoes for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned.
Add the ham, pepper and onion and cook 8 more minutes.
Season with salt, pepper and paprika.
Make four wells in the hash and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook 4-5 minutes until the whites are set.

recipes.title: Classic Guacamole
instructions: Halve the avocados and scoop the flesh into a bowl.
Mash with a fork to your preferred texture.
Stir in the onion, jalapeno, cilantro, lime juice and salt.
Fold in the tomato, taste, and adjust the seasoning.
Serve right away with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Creamy Homemade Hummus
ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, plus more for serving
instructions: Blend the tahini and lemon juice for 1 minute until pale and creamy.
Add the garlic, olive oil, salt and half the chickpeas and blend.
Add the remaining chickpeas and blend until smooth.
With the machine running, add ice water a tablespoon at a time until fluffy.
Serve drizzled with olive oil.

recipes.title: Tomato Basil Bruschetta
instructions: Toast the baguette slices at 400°F for 6-8 minutes until crisp.
Mix the tomatoes, minced garlic, basil, oil, vinegar and salt, and let sit 10 minutes.
Rub each toast with the cut side of the halved garlic.
Spoon the tomato mixture on top and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Spinach Artichoke Dip
ingredients: 10 oz frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Mix the cream cheese, sour cream, mayonnaise and garlic until smooth.
Stir in the artichokes, spinach, mozzarella and half the Parmesan.
Spread into a baking dish and top with the remaining Parmesan.
Bake 25 minutes until bubbly and golden. Serve with chips or bread.

recipes.title: Crispy Buffalo Cauliflower Bites
ingredients: Ranch or blue cheese dip for serving
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°F and line a baking sheet.
Whisk the flour, water and garlic powder into a batter and toss the florets to coat.
Spread on the sheet and bake 20 minutes, flipping halfway.
Toss the baked florets in the buffalo sauce and butter.
Return to the oven for 5 minutes, then serve with dip.

recipes.title: Classic Deviled Eggs
instructions: Place the eggs in a pot, cover with cold water, bring to a boil, then cover and remove from heat for 12 minutes.
Cool in ice water, then peel.
Halve the eggs and scoop the yolks into a bowl.
Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, salt and pepper until smooth.
Spoon or pipe the filling into the whites and dust with paprika.

recipes.title: Garlic Herb Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 20 white button mushrooms, stems removed and minced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Saute the minced stems and garlic in oil for 4 minutes.
Mix with the cream cheese, breadcrumbs, Parmesan and parsley.
Stuff the mushroom caps and arrange on a baking sheet.
Bake 18-20 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Caprese Skewers
instructions: Thread a tomato, a basil leaf and a mozzarella ball onto each small skewer.
Arrange on a platter.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

recipes.title: Creamy Tomato Basil Soup
instructions: Saute the onion in oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes with their juice, broth and sugar and simmer 20 minutes.
Add the basil and blend until smooth.
Stir in the cream, season, and heat through without boiling.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb boneless chicken breasts or thighs
instructions: Saute the onion, carrots and celery in oil for 6 minutes, adding the garlic for the last minute.
Add the broth and chicken and simmer 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the chicken, shred it, and return it to the pot.
Add the noodles and cook until tender, about 6 minutes.
Stir in the parsley and season to taste.

recipes.title: Hearty Minestrone
instructions: Saute the onion, carrots and celery in oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic.
Add the tomatoes, broth, beans and zucchini and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook 8-10 minutes until tender.
Stir in the greens until wilted and season to taste.
Serve topped with Parmesan.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Cook the onions in butter with the sugar and a pinch of salt over medium-low heat for 40 minutes, stirring often, until deeply caramelized.
Deglaze with the wine and cook until nearly evaporated.
Add the broth and thyme and simmer 15 minutes.
Ladle into oven-safe bowls, top with baguette and Gruyere.
Broil until the cheese is bubbling and browned.

recipes.title: Red Lentil Soup
instructions: Saute the onion and carrots in oil for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin and turmeric and cook 1 minute.
Add the lentils and broth and simmer 20 minutes until soft.
Blend partially for a creamy texture.
Stir in the lemon juice and salt.

recipes.title: Smoky Black Bean Soup
ingredients: Lime wedges, cilantro and sour cream for serving
instructions: Saute the onion and pepper in oil for 6 minutes, adding the garlic and spices for the last minute.
Add the beans with their liquid and the broth and simmer 20 minutes.
Mash or blend about half the soup for body.
Serve with lime, cilantro and sour cream.

recipes.title: Roasted Butternut Squash Soup
ingredients: 1 large butternut squash, peeled and cubed
instructions: Toss the squash with oil and roast at 425°F for 30 minutes until caramelized.
Saute the onion and garlic in a pot until soft.
Add the squash, broth and nutmeg and simmer 10 minutes.
Blend until smooth and stir in the coconut milk.
Season to taste and serve warm.

recipes.title: Classic Caesar Salad
instructions: Toss the bread cubes with oil and bake at 375°F for 10 minutes until crisp.
Whisk the mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard, Worcestershire, garlic and half the Parmesan.
Toss the romaine with the dressing.
Top with croutons and the remaining Parmesan.

recipes.title: Greek Salad
instructions: Combine the tomatoes, cucumber, onion and olives in a bowl.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and oregano and pour over the salad.
Toss gently, top with the feta, and season with salt.

recipes.title: Cobb Salad
instructions: Spread the romaine on a large platter.
Arrange rows of chicken, bacon, eggs, avocado, tomatoes and blue cheese on top.
Serve with dressing on the side.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients: 4 large egg yolks plus 1 whole egg
instructions: Boil the spaghetti in salted water, reserving 1 cup of pasta water.
Cook the guanciale in a skillet over medium heat until crisp.
Whisk the eggs, cheese and plenty of black pepper.
Toss the drained pasta in the skillet off the heat, then stir in the egg mixture, adding pasta water a splash at a time until creamy.
Serve immediately with extra cheese.

recipes.title: Fettuccine Alfredo
instructions: Cook the fettuccine until al dente and drain.
Melt the butter in a large skillet and saute the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the cream and simmer for 4 minutes until slightly thickened.
Stir in the Parmesan, nutmeg, salt and pepper until smooth.
Toss the pasta in the sauce and serve.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Bolognese
ingredients: 1 onion, 1 carrot and 1 celery stalk, finely diced
instructions: Brown the beef and pork in a large pot and drain excess fat.
Add the diced vegetables and cook 8 minutes, then add the garlic and tomato paste for 2 minutes.
Pour in the wine and let it reduce, then add the tomatoes and milk.
Simmer uncovered on low heat for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook the spaghetti, toss with the sauce, and serve.

recipes.title: Penne Arrabbiata
instructions: Cook the penne until al dente.
Warm the oil with the garlic and pepper flakes for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 12 minutes until thickened.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and parsley.
Serve with Pecorino.

recipes.title: Basil Pesto Pasta
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted water, reserving 1/2 cup of the water.
Blend the basil, pine nuts, Parmesan, garlic and oil into a pesto.
Toss the drained pasta with the pesto, adding pasta water to loosen.
Fold in the tomatoes and serve.

recipes.title: Classic Meat Lasagna
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F and boil the noodles until just tender.
Brown the beef, drain, and stir in the marinara.
Mix the ricotta, egg, parsley and half the Parmesan.
Layer sauce, noodles, ricotta mixture and mozzarella in a 9x13 dish, repeating to make three layers and finishing with cheese.
Cover with foil and bake 40 minutes, then uncover and bake 15 more minutes. Rest 15 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Stovetop Mac and Cheese
instructions: Cook the macaroni until al dente and drain.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour, and cook 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the milk and simmer until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the cheeses, mustard powder, salt and pepper.
Fold in the macaroni and serve.

recipes.title: Shrimp Pad Thai
ingredients: 3 tbsp tamarind paste or lime juice
instructions: Soak the noodles in warm water until pliable, then drain.
Mix the tamarind, fish sauce and sugar for the sauce.
Stir-fry the shrimp in a hot wok for 2 minutes, then push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 3 minutes.
Add the bean sprouts and scallions, then top with peanuts and lime.

recipes.title: Chicken Lo Mein
instructions: Cook the noodles per package directions and drain.
Stir-fry the chicken in oil until cooked through, then remove.
Cook the vegetables and garlic for 3 minutes.
Return the chicken and add the noodles, soy sauce, oyster sauce and sesame oil.
Toss until everything is heated through and coated.

recipes.title: Cacio e Pepe
instructions: Cook the pasta in a minimal amount of salted water until just shy of al dente.
Toast the pepper in a skillet for 1 minute, then add a ladle of pasta water.
Add the pasta to the skillet with the butter.
Off the heat, stir in the cheese with splashes of pasta water, tossing vigorously until a creamy sauce forms.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Simple Roast Chicken
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F and pat the chicken very dry.
Rub with butter, salt and pepper and stuff the cavity with the lemon, garlic and thyme.
Place on the vegetables in a roasting pan.
Roast 70-80 minutes until the thickest part of the thigh reaches 165°F.
Rest 15 minutes before carving.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Dredge the chicken in flour, then egg, then the breadcrumbs mixed with Parmesan.
Fry in oil for 3 minutes per side until golden.
Place in a baking dish, top with marinara and mozzarella.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes until the cheese is bubbling.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 4 cloves garlic and 1 tbsp grated ginger
Cilantro and basmati rice for serving
instructions: Marinate the chicken in yogurt and half the garam masala for at least 30 minutes.
Sear the chicken in oil until browned and set aside.
Saute the onion, garlic and ginger, add the remaining garam masala, then the tomato sauce.
Simmer 10 minutes, return the chicken, and cook 10 minutes more.
Stir in the cream and serve over rice with cilantro.

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken
instructions: Whisk the oil, lemon juice, garlic, herbs and salt and add the chicken.
Marinate 30 minutes to 4 hours.
Grill over medium-high heat 6-7 minutes per side until it reaches 165°F.
Rest 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb chicken breast, sliced into strips
Lime, sour cream and salsa for serving
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the chicken, peppers and onion with oil and fajita seasoning on a sheet pan.
Roast 20-25 minutes, stirring once, until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve in warm tortillas with lime, sour cream and salsa.

recipes.title: Chicken Teriyaki
ingredients: 1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp water
Sesame seeds and steamed rice for serving
instructions: Simmer the soy sauce, mirin, sugar, vinegar and ginger for 3 minutes.
Sear the chicken in a skillet 5 minutes per side until cooked through.
Pour in the sauce and add the cornstarch slurry, cooking 2 minutes until glossy.
Slice the chicken and serve over rice with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Chicken Thighs
instructions: Season the thighs with salt and pepper and sear skin-side down in an oven-safe skillet for 6 minutes.
Flip, and pour in the honey, soy sauce, garlic and vinegar.
Bake at 400°F for 20-25 minutes until the chicken reaches 175°F.
Spoon the sauce over the top and garnish with scallions.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: Sour cream and cilantro for serving
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F and spread a little sauce in a baking dish.
Mix the chicken, half the cheese, onion and chiles.
Warm the tortillas, fill each with the chicken mixture, roll, and place seam-side down.
Pour the remaining sauce over the top and sprinkle with the remaining cheese.
Bake 20-25 minutes until bubbly.

recipes.title: Chicken Marsala
instructions: Dredge the chicken in seasoned flour and brown in oil, 3 minutes per side. Remove.
Saute the mushrooms until golden, then add the garlic.
Add the Marsala and broth and simmer 8 minutes until reduced by half.
Swirl in the butter, return the chicken, and cook 3 minutes.
Garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: Crispy Baked Chicken Tenders
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F and place a wire rack on a baking sheet.
Mix the panko with the garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper.
Coat the chicken in flour, then egg, then the panko.
Arrange on the rack and spray lightly with cooking spray.
Bake 18-20 minutes until golden and cooked through.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Tacos
instructions: Brown the beef in a skillet and drain the fat.
Stir in the taco seasoning and water and simmer 5 minutes.
Warm the taco shells according to package directions.
Fill with beef and top with lettuce, cheese, tomato, salsa and sour cream.

recipes.title: Juicy Cheeseburgers
instructions: Divide the beef into four loosely formed patties and press a shallow dimple into each center.
Season generously with salt and pepper.
Cook on a hot grill or skillet for 4 minutes per side.
Add the cheese in the last minute to melt.
Serve on toasted buns with your favorite toppings.

recipes.title: Classic Beef Stew
instructions: Toss the beef with flour, salt and pepper and brown in oil in batches.
Saute the onion and garlic, then stir in the tomato paste.
Return the beef, add the broth, bay leaves and thyme, and simmer covered for 1 1/2 hours.
Add the potatoes and carrots and cook 40 minutes more until tender.
Remove the bay leaves and adjust the seasoning.

recipes.title: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
instructions: Toss the beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce and the cornstarch.
Sear the beef in a hot wok in 1 tbsp oil for 2 minutes and remove.
Stir-fry the broccoli, garlic and ginger for 3 minutes with a splash of water.
Add the remaining soy sauce, oyster sauce and sugar.
Return the beef, toss for 1 minute, and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Glazed Meatloaf
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Soak the breadcrumbs in milk, then mix with the beef, eggs, onion, garlic, Worcestershire, salt and pepper.
Shape into a loaf in a baking dish.
Stir together the ketchup, brown sugar and vinegar and spread half over the loaf.
Bake 55-60 minutes, brushing with the remaining glaze near the end, until it reaches 160°F.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork
instructions: Mix the sugar, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper and rub all over the pork.
Place in the slow cooker with the broth.
Cook on low for 8 hours until it falls apart.
Shred the meat, discard excess fat, and toss with the barbecue sauce.
Serve on buns with coleslaw.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Steak
instructions: Let the steaks sit at room temperature for 30 minutes and season well with salt and pepper.
Sear in a very hot cast-iron skillet with oil for 3-4 minutes per side.
Reduce the heat, add the butter, garlic and thyme, and baste the steaks for 1-2 minutes.
Rest for 5 minutes, then slice against the grain.

recipes.title: Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Apples
instructions: Season the chops with salt and pepper and sear in oil for 5 minutes per side until they reach 145°F. Remove.
Cook the apples and shallot in the same pan for 4 minutes.
Add the cider, mustard and thyme and simmer 3 minutes.
Swirl in the butter, return the chops, and spoon the apples over the top.

recipes.title: Lamb Kofta Kebabs
ingredients: Yogurt sauce and pita for serving
instructions: Mix the lamb with the onion, garlic, parsley and spices.
Shape into elongated ovals around skewers.
Grill or broil 10-12 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Serve with yogurt sauce and warm pita.

recipes.title: Korean Beef Bulgogi
instructions: Mix the soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger and pear and marinate the beef for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a skillet over high heat.
Cook the beef in batches for 2-3 minutes until caramelized.
Top with scallions and sesame seeds and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Baked Lemon Garlic Salmon
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet.
Mix the butter, garlic and lemon juice.
Place the salmon on the sheet, season, and brush with the butter mixture.
Top with lemon slices and bake 12-15 minutes until it flakes easily.
Sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
instructions: Melt half the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp in a single layer and cook 2 minutes per side.
Add the garlic and pepper flakes and cook 30 seconds.
Stir in the remaining butter, lemon juice and parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Crispy Fish Tacos
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb white fish such as cod, cut in strips
1/2 cup sour cream mixed with 2 tbsp lime juice
instructions: Whisk the flour, chili powder, salt and beer into a batter.
Dip the fish in the batter and fry in 350°F oil for 3-4 minutes until golden.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with fish, cabbage and lime crema.

recipes.title: Shrimp Fried Rice
instructions: Cook the shrimp in 1 tbsp hot oil for 2 minutes and set aside.
Scramble the eggs in the pan and push aside.
Add the remaining oil, rice and vegetables and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Return the shrimp, add the soy sauce, sesame oil and scallions, and toss to combine.

recipes.title: Maryland Crab Cakes
instructions: Gently fold the crab with the panko, mayonnaise, egg, mustard, Old Bay and parsley.
Form into 8 patties and chill for 30 minutes.
Pan-fry in butter for 4-5 minutes per side until golden.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Miso-Glazed Cod
instructions: Whisk the miso, mirin, sake, sugar and soy sauce until smooth.
Coat the cod and marinate for at least 30 minutes, up to overnight.
Wipe off excess marinade and broil for 8-10 minutes until caramelized and flaky.
Garnish with scallions.

recipes.title: Seared Scallops with Lemon Butter
ingredients: 8 large sea scallops, patted very dry
instructions: Season the scallops with salt and pepper.
Sear in a very hot skillet with oil for about 2 minutes per side until deeply golden.
Lower the heat, add the butter and garlic, and baste for 30 seconds.
Finish with lemon juice and parsley.

recipes.title: Coconut Shrimp Curry
ingredients: Lime juice, basil and jasmine rice
instructions: Fry the curry paste in oil for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, broth, pepper, fish sauce and sugar and simmer 8 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook 3-4 minutes until pink.
Finish with lime juice and basil and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Chickpea Coconut Curry
ingredients: 3 cloves garlic and 1 tbsp ginger, minced
instructions: Saute the onion until soft, then add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk and chickpeas and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Season with salt and serve with rice or naan.

recipes.title: Crispy Tofu Vegetable Stir-Fry
ingredients: 14 oz extra-firm tofu, pressed and cubed
3 cups mixed vegetables (broccoli, peppers, snap peas)
instructions: Toss the tofu with the cornstarch and fry in 2 tbsp oil until crisp on all sides. Remove.
Stir-fry the vegetables and garlic in the remaining oil for 4 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, maple syrup and vinegar.
Return the tofu, toss to coat, and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Smoky Black Bean Burgers
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz) black beans, drained and patted dry
instructions: Mash the beans, leaving some texture.
Mix in the breadcrumbs, rice, spices, garlic and ketchup.
Form into four patties and chill 15 minutes.
Cook in an oiled skillet for 5-6 minutes per side until crisp.
Serve on buns with your favorite toppings.

recipes.title: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Salt the eggplant slices, let sit 20 minutes, then pat dry.
Dredge in flour, egg, then breadcrumbs and bake at 425°F on oiled sheets for 20 minutes, flipping once.
Layer sauce, eggplant and cheeses in a baking dish.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes until bubbly and top with basil.

recipes.title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Mix the rice, beans, corn, salsa, cumin and half the cheese.
Fill the peppers and stand them in a baking dish with a splash of water in the bottom.
Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes, then uncover, top with cheese, and bake 10 more minutes.

recipes.title: Baked Falafel
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, drained and dried
Pita, tahini sauce and salad for serving
instructions: Pulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, herbs and spices in a food processor until coarse but holding together.
Stir in the flour and form into 12 patties.
Arrange on an oiled baking sheet and brush with oil.
Bake at 400°F for 25 minutes, flipping once, until golden.
Serve in pita with tahini sauce.

recipes.title: Palak Paneer
ingredients: 3 cloves garlic and 1 tbsp ginger, minced
instructions: Blanch the spinach for 1 minute, then blend smooth.
Toast the cumin seeds in oil, add the onion, garlic and ginger and cook until golden.
Add the garam masala and turmeric, then the spinach puree, and simmer 8 minutes.
Stir in the cream and paneer and heat through for 4 minutes.
Serve with rice or naan.

recipes.title: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Saute the mushrooms in 1 tbsp butter until golden and set aside.
Cook the onion in 1 tbsp butter until soft, add the garlic and rice, and toast 2 minutes.
Add the wine and stir until absorbed.
Add the broth one ladle at a time, stirring until each is absorbed, about 20-25 minutes total.
Stir in the mushrooms, remaining butter and Parmesan.

recipes.title: Margherita Pizza
ingredients: Flour and cornmeal for the pan
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500°F with a pizza stone or baking sheet inside.
Stretch the dough into a 12-inch round on a floured surface.
Top with the tomatoes seasoned with salt, then the mozzarella.
Bake 10-12 minutes until the crust is blistered and the cheese is bubbling.
Finish with basil and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Tacos
instructions: Toss the sweet potatoes with oil, cumin, chili powder and salt.
Roast at 425°F for 25 minutes, stirring once.
Warm the beans and tortillas.
Fill the tortillas with sweet potato and beans and top with avocado, cilantro, lime and cheese.

recipes.title: Garlic Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cubed
instructions: Boil the potatoes and garlic in salted water for 20 minutes until very tender.
Drain well and return to the pot.
Mash with the butter, then stir in the warm milk until creamy.
Season with salt, pepper and chives.

recipes.title: Simple Roasted Vegetables
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the vegetables with the oil, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Spread in a single layer on a sheet pan.
Roast 25-30 minutes, stirring once, until browned at the edges.

recipes.title: Cilantro Lime Rice
instructions: Rinse the rice and toast it in the butter for 1 minute.
Add the water and salt, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low for 15 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes covered and fluff with a fork.
Stir in the lime juice and cilantro.

recipes.title: Honey Glazed Carrots
instructions: Add the carrots, butter, honey, water and salt to a skillet.
Cover and simmer for 8 minutes until nearly tender.
Uncover and cook 4-5 more minutes until the liquid becomes a glaze.
Top with parsley.

recipes.title: Creamy Coleslaw
instructions: Whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, celery seed, salt and pepper.
Toss with the cabbage and carrots.
Chill at least 30 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Crispy Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F with a baking sheet inside.
Parboil the potatoes in salted water for 8 minutes and drain.
Toss with the oil and spices.
Spread on the hot sheet cut-side down and roast for 35 minutes until deeply golden, flipping once.
Top with rosemary.

recipes.title: Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt.
Beat the butter, both sugars, eggs and vanilla together, then stir in the dry ingredients and chocolate chips.
Scoop onto baking sheets and bake 10-12 minutes until the edges are set.
Cool on the pan for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Fudgy Brownies
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F and line an 8-inch pan.
Melt the butter and stir in the sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Fold in the cocoa, flour and salt, then the chocolate chips.
Bake 28-30 minutes until a toothpick shows moist crumbs.
Cool completely before cutting.

recipes.title: Classic Tiramisu
instructions: Whisk the egg yolks and sugar over simmering water until thick and pale, then cool.
Beat in the mascarpone until smooth.
Whip the cream to stiff peaks and fold into the mascarpone mixture.
Dip the ladyfingers briefly in the espresso and liqueur and layer in a dish.
Spread half the cream over them, repeat the layers, and chill at least 6 hours.
Dust with cocoa before serving.

recipes.title: Lemon Bars
instructions: Mix the butter, powdered sugar and 2 cups of flour, press into a 9x13 pan, and bake at 350°F for 20 minutes.
Whisk the eggs, sugar, lemon juice, zest and 1/4 cup flour.
Pour over the hot crust and bake 20-25 minutes until set.
Cool completely, then dust with powdered sugar and cut.

recipes.title: Warm Apple Crisp
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Toss the apples with the sugar, cinnamon and lemon juice in a baking dish.
Rub the oats, flour, brown sugar and butter together until crumbly.
Sprinkle over the apples and bake 40-45 minutes until bubbling and golden.
Serve warm with ice cream.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Melt the chocolate and butter together and let cool slightly.
Whisk in the egg yolks, sugar and salt.
Whip the cream to soft peaks.
Gently fold the cream into the chocolate in two additions.
Spoon into glasses and chill at least 3 hours.

recipes.title: Vanilla Panna Cotta
ingredients: 1 vanilla bean or 2 tsp vanilla extract
instructions: Sprinkle the gelatin over the water and let bloom for 5 minutes.
Heat the cream, milk, sugar and vanilla until steaming but not boiling.
Whisk in the gelatin until fully dissolved.
Pour into ramekins and chill at least 4 hours.
Unmold or serve in the ramekins topped with berry sauce.

recipes.title: Creamy Rice Pudding
instructions: Combine the rice, milk, sugar and salt in a saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook on low heat for 35-40 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Stir in the vanilla and raisins.
Serve warm or chilled, dusted with cinnamon.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Mix all the ingredients until a soft dough forms.
Roll into balls and place on a baking sheet.
Press with a fork in a crisscross pattern.
Bake 9-10 minutes and cool on the pan.

recipes.title: New York Cheesecake
instructions: Mix the crumbs and butter, press into a 9-inch springform pan, and bake at 325°F for 10 minutes.
Beat the cream cheese and sugar until smooth, then add the eggs one at a time.
Mix in the sour cream, lemon juice, vanilla and flour.
Pour over the crust and bake 60-65 minutes until the edges are set and the center jiggles slightly.
Cool in the oven with the door ajar for 1 hour, then chill at least 6 hours.

recipes.title: Fresh Squeezed Lemonade
instructions: Stir the sugar into the hot water until dissolved.
Combine with the lemon juice and cold water in a pitcher.
Taste and adjust the sweetness.
Serve over ice with lemon slices.

recipes.title: Iced Matcha Latte
instructions: Whisk the matcha with the hot water until smooth and frothy.
Stir in the sweetener.
Fill a glass with ice and milk.
Pour the matcha over the top.

recipes.title: Mango Lassi
instructions: Add all the ingredients to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Taste, adjust the sweetness, and serve chilled.

recipes.title: Rich Hot Chocolate
instructions: Whisk the cocoa and sugar with a splash of milk in a saucepan to make a paste.
Add the remaining milk and heat until steaming.
Whisk in the chocolate until melted and add the vanilla.
Pour into mugs and top as desired.

recipes.title: Moist Banana Bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a loaf pan.
Mix the bananas with the butter, then stir in the sugar, egg and vanilla.
Sprinkle over the baking soda and salt, then fold in the flour until just combined.
Pour into the pan and bake 55-60 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 10 minutes in the pan before slicing.

recipes.title: Sweet Skillet Cornbread
ingredients: 1/3 cup melted butter, plus 1 tbsp for the skillet
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F with a 10-inch cast-iron skillet and 1 tbsp butter inside.
Whisk the dry ingredients.
Stir in the milk, eggs and melted butter until just combined.
Pour into the hot skillet and bake 20-22 minutes until golden.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Rosemary Focaccia
instructions: Mix the flour, yeast, salt and water into a shaggy dough, cover, and rest 2 hours until doubled.
Pour 3 tbsp oil into a 9x13 pan and transfer the dough, stretching it to the edges.
Rest 45 minutes, then dimple deeply with your fingertips.
Drizzle with the remaining oil and sprinkle with rosemary and flaky salt.
Bake at 450°F for 22-25 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Rolls
ingredients: 1/2 cup soft butter and 3/4 cup brown sugar plus 2 tbsp cinnamon for filling
4 oz cream cheese, 2 tbsp butter and 1 cup powdered sugar for icing
instructions: Mix the flour, sugar, yeast and salt, then add the milk, melted butter and egg and knead for 8 minutes.
Let rise for 1 hour until doubled.
Roll into a 12x18-inch rectangle, spread with soft butter, and sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon.
Roll up tightly, slice into 12 rolls, and place in a greased pan. Rise 30 minutes.
Bake at 350°F for 22-25 minutes.
Beat the icing ingredients until smooth and spread over the warm rolls.
